patch.value: Committed CHANGELOG.md drifts from deterministic regeneration after the pm-graph-3svp type classification change, breaking changelog:check on every PR

CI job 95464832813 (PR #64) failed at changelog:check because the committed CHANGELOG.md lists pm-graph-3svp under Added while deterministic regeneration files it under Fixed: the tracker item is type Issue and the committed file predates that classification. A changelog that drifts from its own generator fails every future PR, not just dependency bumps. Fix: pin pm-changelog to 2026.8.12 (peer range accepts the pinned @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.15; caret resolution to 2026.8.17 would ERESOLVE against the 2026.8.15 pin) and regenerate CHANGELOG.md with the repo-installed binary so the committed file matches deterministic output again. Merge withheld this session pending pm-graph-xc7g (history privacy) and pm-graph-fjfn (fail-closed gates) clearance.

value.text: Root cause verified locally: repo-installed pm-changelog 2026.8.12 regenerates CHANGELOG.md with pm-graph-3svp (type Issue) under Fixed; committed file had it under Added. npx-isolated runs drop historical sections because the npx cache cannot resolve the sibling @unbrained/pm-cli for unbounded tracker reads - always regenerate with the repo-installed binary. Fix applied on branch fix/changelog-regenerate-3svp-placement: pin pm-changelog 2026.8.12 + regenerated CHANGELOG.md; npm run changelog:check exits 0.
